Put this album's photos here:
  - cover.jpg        -> used as gallery.js "cover" for album slug "neelum-valley"
  - photo-1.jpg, photo-2.jpg, ... -> used inside its "photos" array

Then in src/data/gallery.js, find the album with slug: "neelum-valley"
and replace the picsum.photos URL with: /images/gallery/neelum-valley/cover.jpg
